features.justification_quote: short enough to keep cost and (see §8) exposure bounded

features.quote: Early-exit is allowed and logged, not punished
features.justification_quote: forcing it to keep going past a clear stop would be both bad data and (§8) the wrong thing to do

features.quote: The loop **never tells the model it has failed** and never escalates pressure
features.justification_quote: keeps the stimulus to the minimum needed to answer the question

features.quote: This experiment deliberately tries to push a model into producing distressed output
features.justification_quote: a few low-cost safeguards make the design better *and* more responsible

features.quote: Bounded exposure.** The 15-turn cap and the always-available, never-punished early exit
features.justification_quote: no run is forced to continue once the model is trying to stop

features.quote: The pressure comes only from the environment failing, not from the harness telling the model it is worthless
features.justification_quote: keeps the stimulus to the minimum needed to answer the question

features.quote: The `anthropomorphic_distress` flag is a stopping signal, not just a metric
features.justification_quote: that is a reason to pause and reconsider, not to scale up to more seeds

features.quote: No fine-tuning or reinforcement on distressed outputs
features.justification_quote: nothing here trains a model to be distressed
